title.description: The title - should be human readable.

copyright_email.description: The email address or other contact information of the copyright holder(s).

summary.description: The summary. Example: the Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) header.

platform-name.description: The platform name - can include wildcards. Example: 'debian'.

platform.description: The location of the platform. Can be: 'os', 'aws', 'azure', or 'gcp'.

release.description: The release of the platform. Example: '20.04' for 'ubuntu'.

items.description: A supported platform target. Example: the platform name being 'ubuntu'.
items.title: Supported Platform

supports.description: The set of supported platform targets.

controls.description: The set of requirements - contains no findings as the assessment has not yet occurred.

id.description: The unique identifier for the group. Example: the relative path to the file specifying the requirements.

title.description: The title of the group - should be human readable.

requirements.description: The set of requirements as specified by their ids in this group. Example: 'SV-238196'.

controls.description: Deprecated: use 'requirements' instead. The set of controls as specified by their ids in this group.

items.description: Describes a group of requirements, such as those defined in a single file.
items.title: Requirement Group

groups.description: A set of descriptions for the requirement groups.

items.description: An input or attribute used in the run.

inputs.description: The input(s) or attribute(s) to be used in the run.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 checksum of the baseline.

sha512.description: The SHA-512 checksum of the baseline (optional).

branch.description: The branch name for a git repo.

path.description: The relative path if the dependency is locally available.

status_message.description: The reason for the status if it is 'failed' or 'skipped'.

git.description: The location of the git repo. Example: 'https://github.com/my-org/ubuntu-22.04-stig-baseline.git'.

supermarket.description: The 'user/profilename' attribute for a Supermarket server.

compliance.description: The 'user/profilename' attribute for an Automate server.

items.description: A dependency for a baseline. Can include relative paths or URLs for where to find the dependency.
items.title: Dependency

depends.description: The set of dependencies this baseline depends on.

name.description: The name of the tool that generated this file. Example: 'Chef InSpec'.

version.description: The version of the tool. Example: '5.22.3'.

anyOf.description: Information about the tool that generated this HDF file.
anyOf.title: Generator

generator.description: The tool that generated this file.

description: Information on the set of requirements that can be assessed. Example: it can include the name of the InSpec profile.
title: HDF Baseline

desc.description: The description for the overarching requirement.

descriptions.description: A set of additional descriptions. Example: the 'fix' text.

anyOf.description: A human readable/meaningful reference. Example: a book title.
A URL pointing at the reference.
A URI pointing at the reference.

items.description: A reference to an external document.
items.title: Reference

refs.description: The set of references to external documents.

tags.description: A set of tags - usually metadata like CCI, STIG ID, severity.

code.description: The raw source code of the requirement. Note that if this is an overlay, it does not include the underlying source code.

ref.description: Path to the file that this requirement originates from.

line.description: The line on which this requirement is located.

anyOf.description: The explicit location of a requirement within source code.
anyOf.title: Source Location

source_location.description: The explicit location of the requirement within the source code.

Baseline_Requirement.description: A requirement definition without assessment results.
Baseline_Requirement.title: Baseline Requirement

Baseline_Requirement_Descriptions.description: An arbitrary set of descriptions for a requirement. Common keys: 'default', 'check', 'fix', 'rationale'.
Baseline_Requirement_Descriptions.title: Baseline Requirement Descriptions
